# DiscardedChangeView
## Rules
### Extends ReadOnlyChangeView
- `DiscardedChangeView` MUST extend `ReadOnlyChangeView` (all shared read accessors).
### Discarded-specific surface
- Extra accessors from latest `discarded` history event: `discardReason` (`reason`), `discardedAt` (`at`), `discardedBy` (`by`), optional `supersededBy`.
- Instance MUST correspond to change whose latest history event is `discarded`.
### Construction
- Only `ChangeRepository` (or port doubles) and `GetDiscarded` MAY construct via `toDiscardedChangeView`.
- Callers obtain via `getDiscarded`, `listDiscarded`, or `GetDiscarded.execute` — not ad-hoc `Change` instantiation in production.
### No mutation path
- No `mutateDiscarded`. Irreversible. Audit/CLI display only.
## Constraints
- Terminology: Discard / Discarded (see core:change).
- Name reuse for new active changes unaffected; collision checks ignore discarded storage.
